summary: The module Go floor must not exceed the catalog's pinned Go toolchain.
reason: With GOTOOLCHAIN=local, package loading failed under the catalog's root .go-version because the generated module required Go 1.26.7 while the catalog runtime is Go 1.26.6.
validated_outcome: Under Go 1.26.6 with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, go list, go mod tidy -diff, build, vet, tests, and govulncheck@v1.3.0 ./... passed; no reachable vulnerabilities were found.
